title: California DMV – Video Overlay + Endcard
summary: In-stream video with a clickable brand overlay and an interactive endcard linking to DMV online services.
description: Served from Collabo's ad server. The video runs with a persistent "DMV online: Ready when you are" overlay and Learn More button, then hands off to an interactive endcard with four service shortcuts: vehicle registration, license renewal, change of address and paperless opt-in. Press play in the preview to watch the full flow.
